Monero
Means Money

Private, decentralized cryptocurrency that keeps your finances confidential and secure.

Get started About Monero

About Monero

Watch this video to understand the basics of how Monero works. For more in-depth understanding of the technology behind Monero, watch more explanatory videos.

Privacy

Monero respects privacy by providing full anonymity and untraceable transactions for users.

Decentralized

With more than 5000 nodes, Monero is one of the most decentralized cryptocurrencies that exist.

Community-driven

Monero is developed and evolved by its community, more than 500 developers have contributed to the project.

Start using Monero

Follow these steps to get started with Monero. If you are new to crypto, we recommend learning the basic security measures you can take to keep your funds safe.

01

Choose a wallet

To use Monero, the first thing you are going to need is a wallet. Visit our Downloads page and find the right wallet for you.

Get a wallet
02

Get coins

You can acquire Monero by mining, or using an exchange to convert your fiat money into XMR.

Find an exchange
03

Spend Monero

Once Monero is in your wallet, you can exchange it for goods, services and other currencies, privately and with very low fees.

Use Monero

Get Involved

Monero is built by a passionate global community. Connect with other members, collaborate with workgroups, or contribute your skills to help shape the future of private money.

Hangouts

Connect with the Monero community on Matrix, IRC, Reddit, and other platforms. Ask questions, share ideas, and meet like-minded privacy advocates.

Join the conversation

Workgroups

Contribute
